description:
As a customer, I want to complete my order.

* The user can finish checkout and see a confirmation.

criteria.text: The user can finish checkout and see a confirmation.

cases.title: Customer finishes checkout and sees a confirmation
cases.preconditions: A customer account exists and is logged in, with <an order ready for checkout (items in the cart)>. The checkout page is reachable.
steps: Open the checkout page for <the order ready for checkout>.
Complete the checkout using <the checkout details required by the application>.
cases.expected: The checkout is completed and a confirmation is shown to the user. The exact content and wording of the confirmation is not specified in the story.
